facts.text: I am trying to find low-carb dessert recipes.
I crave baked goods all the time.
I baked a chocolate cake for my sister's birthday last weekend.
I like the sound of a flourless chocolate cake.
I used apple cider vinegar in an apple pie I made for Thanksgiving.
I am thinking of trying to make croissants from scratch.
I have been intimidated by the laminating process for croissants.
I recently watched a video that made the laminating process seem more manageable.
I found a recipe online that I am planning to try out.
I am worried about getting the croissant layers to flake properly.
I am considering using a stand mixer to help with the laminating process.
